name: Hyperdrive Router unrestricted CALL action abuses user operator approvals
summary: RouterUpgradeable.execute dispatches CALL actions (kind 15) through RouterLib.call to any AddressRegistry-resolved target with caller-supplied calldata, without binding the call to the caller's own account. Users make the Router their market operator and share/WHYPE spender, so any caller could make the Router invoke market.withdrawCollateral, market.borrow or transferFrom naming another user, stealing collateral, borrowing against victims' positions and sweeping approved balances.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion over three merged campaigns of the same Router CALL defect against implementation 0x8c3c47cd: (A) 2025-09-18 by 0x11181b7d via 0xe253c916, withdrawing zero-debt users' collateral from markets 1 and 2 (unreported publicly); (B) 2025-09-27 by 0x9bb54e91, borrowing 672,934 USDT0 against victims' positions in market 3 and withdrawing 110,244.895039 thBILL collateral from market 7 (the publicly reported ~$782k); (C) 2025-09-27 by MEV EOA 0x0000000000004f3d8a, borrowing 42,700.736036 USDT0 in market 3 and sweeping users' approved WHYPE and market shares. Components are priced with DefiLlama at each campaign's first leg; share components carry unit prices derived from convertToAssets at block-1 of each sweep tx times the underlying price. Hyperdrive's later compensation and its reclaim of campaign-C shares do not reduce gross loss. Tiny UBTC (3 base units) and PT-kHYPE collateral are included at DefiLlama prices.

ageReset.description: The last pre-exploit Upgraded event on the Router proxy selected RouterUpgradeable 1.1.0 implementation 0x8c3c47cd with the unrestricted CALL action; the EIP-1967 slot holds it from this block through the whole campaign.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause and earliest exercise. Verified RouterUpgradeable 1.1.0 source for implementation 0x8c3c47cdac47f4abecdd0107551dec7331168d2c: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=999, compiler v0.8.28+commit.7893614a, optimizer 200 runs; SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string 3e048337f2021a89548c9b4a71cafba7cff3b1693f71552a7b05f9ab18288999. Router.execute stores msg.sender as account/sender, then dispatch() handles kind 15 (CALL) by RouterLib.call(addressRegistry().getAddress, CallAction): target = registry lookup of a caller-chosen bytes32 key, then target.functionCallWithValue(caller data). Market keys (keccak("hyperdrive.market.<id>")) and WETH (WHYPE) resolve, so any caller can make the Router call market.borrow/withdrawCollateral/transferFrom or WHYPE.transferFrom naming another account. Users set the Router as market operator (isOperator(account,router)=true; markets approved the Router via SetApprovedOperator at blocks 3633791 and 11153169 for markets 3 and 7) and grant it share/WHYPE allowances, so the market and tokens honour those calls. The patched implementation 0x03e65321dcba6565eb8ca90096633c790a9fd5a7 (SourceCode SHA-256 ecda2ba68b409651daf567b9e0635bd4a032be88965be28945232d5daf871e6a) differs only by commenting out the CALL and SWAP dispatch branches and reverting RouterLib.call/SwapLib.swap. Anchor source-1 (block 14177586, tx index 8, from 0x11181b7d71c28c1e73257541656900e70d8430f2 to its contract 0xe253c916ff35e25173faab0d1bf9cce2e7bbfff0, status 1): debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows the contract reading isOperator(0x758ade2592f90023ab654bad606bb7f54ee9292f, Router)=1 and liabilities=0 on market 1 0x6fcd93da1e2a288ae68bb1d4f856d8d598e8b861, then Router.execute([kind 15]) -> Router CALLs market.withdrawCollateral(0x758ade..., wstHYPE, 394598183892372, Router) (log 20 WithdrawCollateral, caller word = Router) and a second execute (kind 12 ERC20_TRANSFER) moves the wstHYPE to the contract (log 22). The contract's runtime gates entry on keccak(tx.origin) = 0x3ffa3bec...; funds were swept to the EOA at blocks 14178546-14178547 and bridged out via Symbiosis MetaRouterGateway 0xa738e84fde890bc60b99af7cce43990e534304de from fresh EOA 0xffedec0f3aac5abffdbc99c9521455f12479d29b at block 43693511+ (2026). Earliest-use scan: trace_filter (100-block windows) with fromAddress=[Router] and toAddress=[Router] over blocks 13028876..14987447 returns 112684 trace entries in 16208 transactions; flag every Router-originated call borrow 0x6c665a55/withdrawCollateral 0x5a6f45de (arg0), transferFrom 0x23b872dd (arg0), ERC4626 withdraw 0xb460af94/redeem 0xba087652 (arg2) whose named account is neither the Router nor a direct caller of Router in that transaction: 486 calls in 352 transactions, all successful and all by five callers (0xe253c916..., 0x19644bd811542069e36d70101d113f7ea1d9393d, 0x522e7785e5f626c0658c0ffce50a3891db7adff5, 0x000000000000bb1b11e5ac8099e92e366b64c133, 0x000000000000e59fc57340cd50d1b12221601b87); first is source-1. Decoding top-level execute inputs finds the first kind-15 action also in source-1. Direct Router txlist (60876 unique Etherscan rows, blocks 0..15100000) contains only four kind-15 calls, all reverted (0x0c912cdd91713592a13a559b6efdaf55517c8c3d, blocks 14976007-14977503). Independent full-history eth_getLogs scan (blocks 0..15100000) of Borrow 0x630778db..., WithdrawCollateral 0x43358af2... and Withdraw 0x7112ea9e... with caller word = Router finds 18858 events; the only ones whose account differs from tx.from are the 338 campaign events by the same callers, none before source-1. trace_filter over 14987448..15039419 (after the first Router upgrade, markets paused) finds no Router use. The later campaigns (sources 22-26) exercise the same Router CALL path against the same implementation; they are merged.

Reviewed target identity and age history. Router proxy 0x8d9e168a8fd102ea52ba3cc43d4c613bb6c89f32 (ERC1967Proxy, 164-byte runtime keccak 0x0d52a93482e0bcc4d68d1df3db69dc14d8f90320f3145ee0f97eb3a7cc2540db) is created top-level by 0x6b887cac2e0ef29306e1b6f22e716796105137a0 in source-3 (block 1785804, index 0); eth_getCode is empty at 1785803 and the runtime hash is unchanged at 14177585. eth_getLogs Upgraded(address) topic 0xbc7cd75a... on the proxy, blocks 0..22000000, returns seven events: 0x7524dad6... (1785804), 0xd78a541b... (0x21a871), 0x74c40789... (0x4020c6), 0xa2542aa2... (0xc6656a), 0x8c3c47cd... (source-2: block 13028876, tx index 0, log index 2, topic1), then post-exploit 0x0eada264... (14987447) and 0x03e65321... (15039419). EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a1... reads 0xa2542aa2... at 13028875 and 0x8c3c47cd... at 13028876, 14177585 and 14982535. Source-2 is a Safe 0xb08f746e24a5b549ab09e765c7e1d04dec2ffca2 execution by 0xad0010ad7ac48e37c075143067381ef837c80a68, an ordinary admin upgrade. Implementation 0x8c3c47cd... is created top-level by 0x6b887cac... in source-4 (block 13026436, index 8; receipt contractAddress matches); eth_getCode empty at 13026435, 13330-byte runtime keccak 0x533dc1a610c23a4b2207838556a69296fe0d97abf957f789f476ed9954b3f6a0 at 13026436, 13028876, 14177585 and 14982535; anchor trace delegates execute to it. The victim markets are not defect-bearing (they correctly honour operator approvals); their causal configuration (Router operator approval, registry keys) predates the upgrade: market 1 implementation 0x262636c4bc729bee8b106564e53aad2dd72c3c9f, market 3 implementation since block 4291633, market 7 since 11153169, SetApprovedOperator(Router,true) at 3633791 and 11153169. The latest pre-exploit code activation establishing the vulnerable combination is therefore source-2; age = 1758197811 - 1757067780 = 1130031 s.

Reviewed complete gross campaign loss from the 352 flagged receipts (eth_getTransactionReceipt, all status 1). A (source-1 and source-27, 27 txs, blocks 14177586-14178258, caller 0xe253c916...): WithdrawCollateral events with caller=Router, summed by indexed token: market 2 0x167101b7...: WHYPE 9613308410561228131292 (9 events; 9601 WHYPE from 0x80ef93663b39a839ce09a965b06bbf9a9f671a9b), UETH 400000000000000000, UBTC 3 (8 decimals); market 1: wstHYPE 62064110911398192264 (11), kHYPE 12506020102059650865 (5), PT-kHYPE-13NOV2025 1016645407482562369 (1). All victims had liabilities 0; collateral is gross depletion. B (source-22 to source-24, 0x9bb54e918cca826f5ead55bf4641c693ce3ce316): 277 txs via 0x19644bd8..., blocks 14968643-14971115, Borrow events on market 3 with caller=Router, receiver = contract, fee 0: 672934000000 USDT0 against victim accounts; 12 txs via 0x522e7785..., blocks 14971189-14971355, WithdrawCollateral on market 7: 110244895039 thBILL. These equal CertiK's 672,934 USDT0 and 110,244 thBILL (source-8). C (source-25 and source-26; EOA 0x0000000000004f3d8aaf9175fd824cb00ad4bf80): 21 txs via 0x000000000000bb1b11e5..., blocks 14972235-14974530, Borrow on market 3: 42700736036 USDT0, sold into Uniswap V3 pool 0xbd19e19e4b70eb7f248695a42208bc1edbbfb57d at block 14972552; 15 txs via 0x000000000000e59fc573..., blocks 14981761-14982535, Router CALL transferFrom of victims' ERC20 balances to the bot, summed from receipt Transfer logs (from in the flagged call set, to = bot): WHYPE 1500984000000000000 and market shares HD-MKT-HYPE 213561520973204909883, HD-MKT-USDT0 7120752888, HD-MKT-TSY-USDT0 3419533576, HD-MKT-PNR-USDT0 9828000000, HD-MKT-USDe 2284491195082528780305, HD-MKT-USDC(0xeb3f65fc...) 3369748. Shares are valued by eth_call convertToAssets(shares moved in each tx) at that tx's block-1: 215885372735111354153 WHYPE, 7289310600 + 3452326350 + 9878010197 USDT0, 2342382102813024158827 USDe, 3369764 USDC, times the campaign-C DefiLlama price of the underlying asset (component unitPriceUsd = underlying/shares x price). Decimals read at pre-campaign blocks: WHYPE/wstHYPE/kHYPE/UETH/PT/USDe/HD-MKT-HYPE/HD-MKT-USDe 18, USDT0/thBILL/USDC and other shares 6, UBTC 8. Hyperdrive later reclaimed the bot's shares to 0x4a3e7df95677282cd2a21d7da7f18fe8b74b830b inside its market upgrade tx 0x9651372fe18181eabfc1a67b9d66901a5ea2c8a60628feaff1eb959f392d41d2 (block 15402979) and compensated users; recoveries do not reduce gross loss. Borrowed amounts are victim depletion (debt booked on victims' positions); attacker inputs are nil. Each campaign is valued at its own first-leg DefiLlama price. Exact decimal sum 1419492.740555350424941489 USD; JSON number is its nearest IEEE-754 value.

notes: The publicly reported incident (CertiK source-8, The Block source-21; ~$782k, 2025-09-27) is campaign B. The same defect had already been exploited on 2025-09-18 (source-1), nine days earlier, so the record anchors there; campaign A and the copycat campaign C are merged as later/earlier actors against the same implementation. Router was upgraded to 0x0eada264 at block 14987447 and to 0x03e65321 (CALL/SWAP disabled) at 15039419.
